page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable rules in markdown. Attach them to agents; each enabled skill becomes its own block in the review prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill, or import one from a markdown file or a .zip archive.

card.deleteBody: “{name}” will be detached from {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} and its version history deleted. This cannot be undone.

panel.disabled: Disabled — not added to any prompt

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Short, unique, kebab-case. Shown as the block header in the prompt.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag tests that only cover the happy path of a changed branch.
form.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface: phrase it as a directive — what should the agent do, and when?

form.bodyHint: Inserted verbatim into the prompt of every agent this skill is attached to.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: Write a rule your agents should check against.

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: Upload a .md file or a .zip archive. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.fileHint: .md or .zip, up to 512 KiB. From an archive only the markdown file is read (SKILL.md first); scripts and other files are ignored and never run.
import.trustNotice: Someone else's skill is someone else's instructions inside your agent's prompt. It is saved disabled; read it before you enable it.
import.ignored: Ignored {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} (not read, not executed):

config.enabledHint: A disabled skill stays attached to agents but is left out of their prompts.
config.versionHint: Saving a changed body creates a new version.

versioning.hint: Every body change is a version. Restore saves an old body as a new version; nothing is overwritten.
versioning.tooLarge: Too large to diff line by line; showing both bodies in full.
